propositions: The plan-review gate has no criterion to evaluate whether a proposed change is actually needed, leaving a gap in detecting over-action (adding mechanisms without establishing necessity).
Bug tickets currently bypass substantive plan-review via an exempt-PASS verdict with zero LLM calls, precluding any review of bug plans.
A new advisory pass-1 criterion 'necessity' must flag plans that do not demonstrate the change is needed (no reproduction or motivation), distinct from asserted-capability.
Bugs must receive a lightweight advisory review tier consisting of the DET floor plus the necessity probe, never blocking, instead of short-circuiting to exempt-PASS.

The necessity probe and bug review tier must be registered advisory (never block), auto-monitored by the standing recorder, and eligible for later advisory->blocking promotion via operator attestation.
